text: {"danger_level":"orange","danger_reason":"An active LPG tanker fire presents a major explosion hazard within 1 km of your location in Teynampet.","main_move":"MOVE_AWAY","main_move_text":"Move away from the LPG tanker fire and shelter inside a solid building away from glass windows if evacuation is difficult.","where_to_go":"Move at least 1.5 km away towards Nandanam Signal to the southeast or stay inside a sturdy concrete building if moving with vulnerable people is unsafe.","do_now":[{"text":"Assist elderly family members and children to get away from direct line of sight of the tanker fire.","advice_ids":["ADV_EVAC_VULNERABLE"]},{"text":"Close all windows, doors, and shutters to protect against potential blast waves and radiant heat.","advice_ids":["ADV_SHELTER_BLAST"]},{"text":"Stay tuned to official emergency broadcasts and local authorities for evacuation orders.","advice_ids":["ADV_LISTEN_OFFICIALS"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not go near the fire site to watch or take photographs.","advice_ids":["ADV_DONOT_CROWD"]},{"text":"Do not use open flames, matches, or electrical switches in case gas has leaked nearby.","advice_ids":["ADV_DONOT_IGNITE"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"With elderly people, children or someone who needs help","text":"Prioritize moving them into an interior room on a lower floor away from windows if immediate outdoor evacuation is too slow or risky.","advice_ids":["ADV_ASSIST_NEEDS"]}],"call":["112","101","108"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Location coordinates and hazard type are clearly defined in Teynampet area.","unknowns":["Exact wind direction and extent of the flammable vapor plume."],"valid_while":["Until the fire is fully extinguished by emergency services and the explosion threat is cleared."]}
